title: Abusive text transformation using LLMs
reasoning: The paper explicitly includes 'Religion' as one of the core categories used to evaluate and benchmark the ability of various LLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Groq) to detect and transform abusive content. It features specific analysis of religious-based hate speech, n-gram comparisons for religious topics, and examples of how models rephrase religious-based insults.
